Involvement

Act Two

Moonrise Towers

Daine is on a balcony of Moonrise Towers, on the eastern side of the first floor playing cards with  Zealot Bennel. Daine attempts to cheat at cards, but Bennel notices and then deducts that Daine was a former Flaming Fist mercenary.[1] Talking with Daine lets her ask the party if they have any news or marching orders.

Defending Moonrise Towers

If the  Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Daine is part of the remaining forces defending Moonrise Towers, and moves to the center of the throne room. Should the party enter the throne room prematurely, or kill a few Absolutists in the hall, she joins combat.

Idle banter

Daine will occassionally chat with fellow guard  Bennel

  • Acolyte Daine
    I'm sick as shit of looking at your mug. The sooner we march, the better.
  • Zealot Bennel
    The General's just wrapping up a few loose ends. Besides - city's going nowhere.
  • Acolyte Daine
    Not 'til we get there, anyway.
  • Zealot Bennel
    You were Flaming Fist before this, weren't you lass?
  • Acolyte Daine
    Save your 'lasses' for when you're courting. But aye - how d'you know?
  • Zealot Bennel
    You cheat. Badly.
  • Acolyte Daine
    Ugh. There's blood on these cards.
  • Zealot Bennel
    Aye. My brother's. Had to deal with him after he struck a True Soul - claimed she was some kind of monster.
  • Zealot Bennel
    Had to toss him over that terrace there.
  • Acolyte Daine
    Gods.
  • Zealot Bennel
    God. We belong to just the one now, remember.
